text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity for keyboard navigation. This keeps the focus indicator visible on all backgrounds while avoiding the blur of thicker rings that can clash with high-contrast themes. The trade-off is slightly reduced sharpness on dark modes, but the glow ensures visibility without overwhelming the interface.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring + 2px glow risks blurring focus on high-contrast backgrounds—WCAG 2.2 AA demands 3:1 contrast for focus indicators, and a 2px glow at 20% opacity (#005FCC) fails this on white. Use a 3px solid ring (#005FCC) instead; it meets contrast, stays sharp on dark themes, and avoids mobile crowding. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation checks to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—buttons under 32px may lose 6px of tap space. A better alternative: 2px solid #005FCC with 2px outer glow at 40% opacity. Test this on a 28px button at 120% zoom; if tap success rate stays above 95%, it’s the safer choice.
